login.title: Connect to your assistant
login.text: This browser could not be recognized automatically. Paste the Kreafinity access token.
login.invalid: Token refused. Check it and try again.
error.network: Kreafinity does not answer. Is the daemon running?
error.busy: A request is already running in this conversation.
error.keyring_unavailable: No system keyring is available on this computer.
sidebar.waiting: An action is waiting for your approval
conversation.delete_confirm: Delete the conversation "{title}"? This cannot be undone.
picker.key_missing: The {provider} API key is not set up.
welcome.title: Hello {name}, what can I do for you?
welcome.text: I can find and organize your files, open your applications or tell you about your computer. Nothing is changed without your approval.
welcome.suggestion.1: Show me the 5 largest files in my Downloads folder
welcome.suggestion.2: How is my computer doing? (CPU, memory, disk)
welcome.suggestion.4: Create a "Projects" folder in my Documents
composer.hint: Every action on your computer is shown to you before it happens.
tool.list_directory.help: List the files of a folder.
tool.list_applications.help: List the applications of the computer.
tool.move_file.help: Move or rename a file or folder.
tool.open_file.help: Open a file with its application.
tool.open_url.help: Open an address in the browser.
tool.move_to_trash.help: Send files to the trash (they can be restored).
tool.set_volume.help: Set the volume, mute or unmute.
tool.set_brightness.help: Set the brightness of a laptop's screen.
tool.run_command.help: Run a command with your rights (shown in full before it runs).
tool.install_package.help: Install system packages; the system asks for your administrator password.
approval.confirm_check: I checked the list and I confirm
approval.expired: Too late: the action was denied.
approval.elsewhere: An action is waiting for your approval in another conversation.
notice.iteration_limit: Request stopped: the step limit was reached.
notice.max_tokens: Answer cut off: the length limit was reached.
notice.provider_auth: The API key of this provider is missing or refused.
notice.provider_unavailable: The AI provider cannot be reached: {message}
settings.title: Settings
settings.ai.title: Artificial intelligence
settings.ai.text: Choose the AI used by default, and the one taking over when the Internet does not answer.
settings.keys.title: API keys
settings.keys.text: Keys are kept in the system keyring, never in a file.
settings.keys.no_keyring: No system keyring is available on this computer: use the environment variables shown.
settings.keys.label: {provider} API key
settings.tools.title: Allowed tools
settings.tools.text: What the AI can do on your computer. Actions needing approval are always shown to you first.
settings.folders.title: Accessible folders
settings.folders.text: One folder per line (~ is your home folder). Sensitive folders (.ssh, keyrings…) always stay off-limits.
settings.general.title: General
update.title: A Kreafinity update is available
update.restarting: Kreafinity will restart; this page reloads by itself.
update.too_long: The update takes longer than expected. Reload the page in a few minutes.
settings.updates.dev: Development copy: update it with git.
settings.memory.title: Memory
settings.memory.text: Kreafinity remembers you from one conversation to the next and learns from each one. Everything stays on this computer; you can read, fix or erase it all.
settings.memory.no_skills: None yet: Kreafinity saves some after multi-step tasks.
settings.memory.forget_confirm: Erase everything Kreafinity remembers (notes, skills and the personality it built)? Your conversations are kept.
tool.memory.help: Remember what is useful from one conversation to the next (preferences, corrections).
tool.skill.help: Save and improve procedures that worked.
tool.search_conversations.help: Recall what was said in past conversations.
settings.memory.soul_text: Kreafinity's character, written by itself. It grows it as you talk; you can also edit it. It changes how it speaks, never its rules.
settings.memory.soul_seed: Starting personality: Kreafinity has not grown it yet.
settings.memory.soul_reset_confirm: Give Kreafinity back its original personality? The one it built will be erased.
settings.memory.soul_was_reset: Kreafinity is back to its original personality.
tool.soul.help: Grow its own personality as you talk.
tool.set_appearance.help: Light, dark or Kreafinity theme, and wallpaper (KDE Plasma, GNOME).
tool.arrange_window.help: Bring a window forward, minimize, maximize or snap it left or right (KDE Plasma).
voice.busy: Kreafinity is listening to what you said…
voice.not_ready: Voice is not ready yet: prepare it in the settings.
voice.preparing: Voice is being prepared, one moment…
voice.no_microphone: The microphone cannot be used: check that it is plugged in and allowed.
voice.nothing_heard: I heard nothing. Try again, a little louder.
voice.failed: I could not understand the recording: {message}
settings.voice.title: Voice
settings.voice.text: Talk to Kreafinity with the microphone button, and it answers aloud. On this computer, your voice never leaves the machine.
settings.voice.installing: Installing the voice engines… (a few minutes)
settings.voice.ready_listening: Recognition is ready; the reading voice is not installed.
settings.voice.missing: Voice is not installed on this computer yet (about 600 MB to download).
